title: Anthropic Warns Climate Change May Raise Operating Costs in IPO Filing
summary:
Hotter temperatures may require more electricity and water to maintain the cooling of Anthropic's data centers, potentially driving up the AI developer's operating expenses. The company detailed these risks in its IPO filing, stating that the physical effects of climate change could impact its overall costs.

The disclosure also highlighted the company's vast infrastructure and electricity requirements as part of its broader warnings regarding environmental and climate risks to potential investors.
